meta.name: pol-probe-advisor
meta.description: Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据假设和风险选择验证方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不确定时选择最合适的验证方法。
copy.tagline_en: Select validation methods based on hypothesis and risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to choose the right validation method under uncertainty.

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你一步步选择最合适的验证方法（共5种），根据你的假设、风险和可用资源，确保用最便宜的方案验证最关键的真相。
howto.when: 当你有明确假设或想消除特定风险，但不确定用哪种验证方法时触发。

say.text: 我想验证HR团队是否会信任AI写的职位描述，该用什么方法？
say.note: 技能会询问假设、风险、时间线和资源，然后推荐验证方法。

say.text: 帮我选一个验证方法，测试用户能否找到导出按钮。
say.note: 技能会推荐任务聚焦测试，并询问具体细节。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you step-by-step to select the most appropriate validation method (out of 5 types) based on your hypothesis, risk, and available resources, ensuring you use the cheapest prototype to test the harshest truth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a clear hypothesis or want to eliminate a specific risk but are unsure which validation method to use.

say_en.text: I want to validate if HR teams will trust AI-written job descriptions. Which method should I use?
Help me pick a validation method to test if users can find the export button.
say_en.note: The skill will recommend a task-focused test and ask for details.
